t.text: Twist · The dial: calmer, more minimal

n1.text: Variants · top row 1:30, bottom row idle

annotations.text: A · Same Braun object, just quieter: no numerals, no shadows or gradients, 4 hour marks + 15-min dots, flat knob. Knob is back to the full size (as big as now), flat, with a thicker pointer.
B · No face. A track ring fills with orange; you drag the white handle at its end. Most “iOS”, least like a kitchen timer.
C · Only the orange slice and a hairline circle. The black dot on the rim is what you grab. Keeps the wedge (the brand mark) and drops everything else.
D · The dial is one big graphite knob with an orange notch; the time lights up the dots around it. The most tactile: you clearly turn a thing.
E · A bezel of ticks; the ones covered by time light up orange. No disc, no knob, no wedge. Quietest, closest to a watch.
